title: Akoi Meexx: Unforked
description: An in-world entity manipulation datapack designed to prevent entities like loyalty tridents and falling dragon eggs from becoming lost in the void
body:
## Unforked!

Unforked! is a datapack written to prevent entities like loyalty tridents and falling dragon eggs from becoming lost due to void damage (-128 or lower in overworld, -64 or lower in other dimensions), bringing some semblence of feature parity with bedrock trident behavior in that regard.

This pack aims to work in any dimension, even custom ones.


**Features**
- Prevents tridents from being deleted in the void by sending them back to their owner, just as if you hit something
- Prevents falling dragon eggs from being deleted in the void by `/spreadplayer`'ing them to an area around the nearest player
- Translatable text where applicable (hint: just the pack.mcmeta)

**Future Planned Features**
- None at this time
